        count(*) AS count_1,
        avg(ss_ext_tax) AS avg_ext_tax_1,
        avg(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) AS avg_net_paid_inc_tax_1
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20
),
bucket_2 AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        count(*) AS count_2,
        avg(ss_ext_tax) AS avg_ext_tax_2,
        avg(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) AS avg_net_paid_inc_tax_2
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40
),
bucket_3 AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        count(*) AS count_3,
        avg(ss_ext_tax) AS avg_ext_tax_3,
        avg(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) AS avg_net_paid_inc_tax_3
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60
),
bucket_4 AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        count(*) AS count_4,
        avg(ss_ext_tax) AS avg_ext_tax_4,
        avg(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) AS avg_net_paid_inc_tax_4
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80
),
bucket_5 AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        count(*) AS count_5,

        avg(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) AS avg_net_paid_inc_tax_5
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN bucket_1.count_1 > 1071 THEN bucket_1.avg_ext_tax_1
        ELSE bucket_1.avg_net_paid_inc_tax_1
    END AS bucket1,
    CASE
        WHEN bucket_2.count_2 > 39161 THEN bucket_2.avg_ext_tax_2
        ELSE bucket_2.avg_net_paid_inc_tax_2
    END AS bucket2,
    CASE
        WHEN bucket_3.count_3 > 29434 THEN bucket_3.avg_ext_tax_3
        ELSE bucket_3.avg_net_paid_inc_tax_3
    END AS bucket3,
    CASE
        WHEN bucket_4.count_4 > 6568 THEN bucket_4.avg_ext_tax_4
        ELSE bucket_4.avg_net_paid_inc_tax_4
    END AS bucket4,
    CASE
        WHEN bucket_5.count_5 > 21216 THEN bucket_5.avg_ext_tax_5
        ELSE bucket_5.avg_net_paid_inc_tax_5
    END AS bucket5
FROM reason
INNER JOIN bucket_1 ON reason.r_reason_sk = 1
